items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Then we had Wash -- Milton Washington -- playing trumpet. And I was playing trumpet. So we had eight pieces.

ctx.x: playing tenor. A cat we called Cragbrains -- Cragbrains Page -- was playing tenor. Then Butch Hamilton was playing alto. Then we had Wash -- Milton Washington -- playing trumpet. And I was playing trumpet. So we had eight pieces. I stayed up there until that one closed. Then they opened up again, out there somewhere where Charlie's is, 26th Street -- somewhere out there.
